title: 8a.nu Send Grade Style Leaderboard
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eighta:send
| stats avg(grade_index) as avg_value max(grade_index) as peak_value count as sessions by style
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks style values by average and peak send grade index, helping you see where 8a.nu send grade performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which style contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `style` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of style, average send grade index, and peak send grade index.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which style areas give you the strongest 8a.nu send grade results.
